sentences.en: So, wait, what's the plan here?
sentences.zh: 等等，那接下来的计划是什么？

sentences.en: How do we get her to reverse the curse?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么让她解除诅咒？

sentences.en: Reverse the curse?
You're kidding, right?
Yeah, witches don't reverse the curse.
And no reverse curse, curse reverse, brother.
sentences.zh: 而且没有什么解咒、诅咒反转这种好事，老弟。

sentences.en: There is no curse reverse.
There is no such thing as witches, you freaking weirdos!
sentences.zh: 根本没有女巫这玩意儿，你们这群死变态！

sentences.en: Young lady, I take that as a compliment.
sentences.zh: 年轻的小姐，我把这当作是赞美。

sentences.en: Einstein was a weirdo.
Darwin, Galileo.
Weirdos, all.
You can roll your eyes at words like unexplained phenomena, but guess what?
sentences.zh: 你们可以对“未解之谜”这种词嗤之以鼻，但猜怎么着？

sentences.en: All phenomena is unexplained until someone explains it.
sentences.zh: 所有现象在被解释之前都是未解之谜。

sentences.en: Uh, guys?
Unlike those bone polishers at the Natural History Museum, we're on a vanguard of scientific discovery.
sentences.zh: 不同于自然历史博物馆里那些只会擦骨头的家伙，我们正处于科学发现的前沿。

sentences.en: The front line, the tip of the spear, the threshold of...
sentences.zh: 最前线，尖端阵地，门槛之——

sentences.en: Guys!
Sand points, and they see what he's pointing at.
sentences.zh: 桑德指着前方，他们顺着他指的方向看去。

sentences.en: Carl is knocking on Rachel's door.
We watch from across the street.
Well, he's going to die.
This is going to be good.
We should film this.
They start filming as Rachel answers the door and sees Carl.
sentences.zh: 他们开始拍摄瑞秋开门并看到卡尔的画面。

sentences.en: Carl?
Did you put a curse on me?
What?
The others watch as Carl and Rachel start arguing.
sentences.zh: 其他人看着卡尔和瑞秋争吵起来。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm leaving.
Nessie stands up and starts to walk away as Rachel and Carl keep arguing.
sentences.zh: 内西站起身准备离开，而瑞秋和卡尔还在继续争吵。

sentences.en: Carl is getting impassioned.
Just answer the question.
Are you a witch?
Can you please not expectorate in my face?
sentences.zh: 能请你别把口水喷到我脸上一脸吗？

sentences.en: Back behind the car, Sam's eyes bolt open.
sentences.zh: 退回到车后面，萨姆猛地睁大了眼睛。

sentences.en: Tell me you all just heard that.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你们刚刚都听到了。

sentences.en: Nessie, get down!
You don't know what you're up againSt.
sentences.zh: 你根本不知道你的对手是谁。

sentences.en: Yes, I do.
I am up against my own misguided expectations of what life in New York was going to be like.
sentences.zh: 我的对手是我自己对纽约生活那些不切实际的错误期待。

sentences.en: Because instead of working at an actual museum with actual scientists, I'm stuck with a bunch of crackpots who think witches are real, which they are not.
sentences.zh: 因为我没有去真正的博物馆和真正的科学家共事，而是被困在了一群以为世界上有女巫的怪咖中间，而实际上根本没有。

sentences.en: And just then, across the street, as Carl yells at Rachel, we see Rachel look one way down the block and then the other.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，在街对面，当卡尔对瑞秋大喊时，我们看到瑞秋看了看街区的一端，然后又看了看另一端。

sentences.en: The coast is clear.
She takes out a wand.
And zap, she turns Carl into a frog.
sentences.zh: 伴随着一声魔咒，她把卡尔变成了一只青蛙。

sentences.en: Everyone is stunned.
Expectorate.
Crazy.
And that's the end of act two.
Act three.
We are interior of the Belfry.
sentences.zh: 我们在钟楼酒吧的内部。

sentences.en: It's the old Irish bar where the museum crew hangs out.
sentences.zh: 那是博物馆员工经常去的古老爱尔兰酒吧。

sentences.en: Pete, Nessie, Lindsay, and Sam sit, silently drinking beers.
sentences.zh: 皮特、尼斯、林赛和萨姆坐着，默默地喝着啤酒。

sentences.en: In the middle of the table is a large bullfrog.
sentences.zh: 桌子中间有一只巨大的牛蛙。

sentences.en: Nessie is in silent shock.
sentences.zh: 尼斯陷入了无声的震惊中。

sentences.en: Well, there's obviously a lot to process here, but speaking purely as a scientist, how cool was that?
sentences.zh: 好吧，显然这里有很多事情需要消化，但纯粹从科学的角度来说，那有多酷？

sentences.en: A guy got turned into a bullfrog, Pete.
sentences.zh: 一个家伙变成了一只牛蛙，皮特。

sentences.en: Not exactly cause for a pizza party.
sentences.zh: 这可算不上开披萨派对的理由。

sentences.en: I don't know.
Bullfrogs are cool.
Maybe you should do the guy a favor.
sentences.zh: 也许你应该帮那家伙一把。

sentences.en: A favor?
He's an amphibian.
Bullfrogs can jump ten times their own height.
sentences.zh: 牛蛙能跳出自身高度十倍的距离。

sentences.en: Who wouldn't love to be able to do that?
sentences.zh: 谁不想拥有这种能力呢？

sentences.en: I know I would.
You'd rather be a bullfrog than a human being.
sentences.zh: 你宁愿当一只牛蛙也不愿当人。

sentences.en: They catch food with their tongues.
Flies, Sam.
They catch flies.
Yeah, and to a bullfrog, a fly is like the most delicious thing ever.
sentences.zh: 对啊，对于牛蛙来说，苍蝇简直就是世上最美味的东西。

sentences.en: A fly is a bullfrog-banana split.
sentences.zh: 苍蝇对牛蛙来说就像香蕉船冰淇淋一样。

sentences.en: Hey, I wonder if female frogs hate frog Carl.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我在想母蛙会讨厌青蛙卡尔吗？

sentences.en: Nessie, I need you to go down to the pond in Central Park, get three, no, ten, ten female frogs.
sentences.zh: 尼斯，我需要你去中央公园的池塘，抓三只，不，十只，十只母蛙。

sentences.en: Finally, Nessie gets up, visibly shaken.
sentences.zh: 终于，尼斯站了起来，明显受到了惊吓。

sentences.en: I'm moving back to Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 我要搬回威斯康星州去了。

sentences.en: She starts to leave, but Lindsay stands up.
sentences.zh: 她正要离开，但林赛站了起来。

sentences.en: Whoa.
So you're just leaving?
As soon as possible, yes.
But I thought we had a nice little friendship form in here.
sentences.zh: 但我以为我们在这里建立了一段美好的友谊呢。

sentences.en: What?
All you do is make fun of me.
That's how you treat your friends?
sentences.zh: 这就是你对待朋友的方式吗？

sentences.en: How does it work in Wisconsin?
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州是怎么样的？

sentences.en: Nessie shakes her head and exits.
sentences.zh: 尼斯摇了摇头，走了出去。

sentences.en: The waitress appears and looks at the bullfrog, kind of perplexed.
sentences.zh: 女服务员走了过来，看着那只牛蛙，显得有点困惑。

sentences.en: After a beat.
Carl?
We go to the river walk.
Nessie is walking along the river on her phone.
sentences.zh: 内西正一边打电话一边沿着河边走。

sentences.en: Mom?
Sam catches up with her.
No, Nessie, no.
Hang up the phone.
He tries to take the phone from her.
sentences.zh: 他试图从她手里抢过手机。

sentences.en: They wrestle for it.
sentences.zh: 两人为争夺手机扭打起来。

sentences.en: No, Mom.
I'm not being mugged.
It's just this weird guy I work with.
sentences.zh: 只是我共事的这个怪人。

sentences.en: This is for your own good.
In the struggle, the phone goes flying into the East River.
sentences.zh: 在争夺中，手机飞进了东河。

sentences.en: Splash.
A long beat, and then...
Okay.
We need to get a bag of rice.
You owe me a phone.
Yes, I owe you a phone.
But hear me out.
You can't leave.
You can't give up.
New York is rough, no doubt.
sentences.zh: 纽约确实很难混，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: When it's cold, it is up yours cold.
sentences.zh: 冷起来的时候，那真是刺骨的冷。

sentences.en: When it's hot, it is screw you hot.
sentences.zh: 热起来的时候，那真是操蛋的热。

sentences.en: And yes, sometimes people get turned into frogs.
sentences.zh: 而且没错，有时候人会变成青蛙。

sentences.en: There is dark magic here, no doubt.
sentences.zh: 这里确实存在黑魔法，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: But there's also good magic.
sentences.zh: 但这里也有美好的魔法。

sentences.en: I mean...
He gestures off camera, and we swing around to a postcard view of the Brooklyn Bridge,
sentences.zh: 他朝镜头外挥了挥手，镜头转到了布鲁克林大桥明信片般的风景，

sentences.en: then right back to Nessie.
The view has the desired effect on her.
sentences.zh: 这景色对她起到了预期的效果。

sentences.en: She softens for a moment, and then...
sentences.zh: 她的态度缓和了一会儿，然后……

sentences.en: Okay.
Yes, beautiful bridge.
But witches?
That stuff just doesn't happen in Greenleaf.
sentences.zh: 这种事在格林利夫根本不会发生。

sentences.en: Neither does that stuff.
He points to the bridge, and again, we swing around to a postcard shot.
sentences.zh: 他指着桥，镜头再次转向明信片般的画面。

sentences.en: Only this time, in the foreground, a two-foot-long rat emerges from a trash can and scurries away.
sentences.zh: 只是这一次，在前景中，一只两英尺长的老鼠从垃圾桶里钻出来，仓皇逃窜。

sentences.en: Nessie screaMs.
It's terrifying.
Back on Nessie and Sam holding each other.
sentences.zh: 画面回到内西和萨姆互相拥抱。

sentences.en: Oh my god, that is going to give me nightmares.
sentences.zh: 天哪，这绝对会让我做噩梦的。

sentences.en: That really will.
Look.
Sam stops himself from gagging, and then...
sentences.zh: 萨姆强忍住作呕的感觉，然后……

sentences.en: Oh, look.
New York isn't the guarantee that something great is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 纽约并不能保证一定会有什么伟大的事情发生。

sentences.en: But it is the chance that it might.
sentences.zh: 但它给了这种可能一个机会。

sentences.en: At any moment.
And if you ask me...
That's worth a few witches.
sentences.zh: 这绝对值得付出几个女巫的代价。

sentences.en: And rats.
And whatever that creepy, heavyset gentleman is doing over there in the bushes.
sentences.zh: 以及那边灌木丛里那个举止诡异、身材魁梧的绅士在搞的什么鬼。

sentences.en: Oh, don't look!
Nessie can't help but smile at this.
New York needs people with good magic inside them, Nessie.
sentences.zh: 纽约需要内心怀揣美好魔法的人，尼斯。

sentences.en: Or else we're loSt.
New York needs you.
Off Nessie, thinking about this, we go to the belfry.
sentences.zh: 随着尼斯陷入沉思，我们镜头转到了钟楼。

sentences.en: Lindsay and Pete continue to ponder frog philosophy.
sentences.zh: 琳赛和皮特继续琢磨着青蛙哲学。

sentences.en: Oh, sack up, Lindsay.
Middle school science classes do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 初中科学课经常这么干。

sentences.en: You are not going to dissect Carl.
Just then, Nessie rushes in, grabs the frog, and runs out.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，尼斯冲了进来，抓起青蛙就跑了出去。

sentences.en: On the street, Nessie marches up to Rachel's door.
sentences.zh: 在街上，尼斯径直走到雷切尔的门口。

sentences.en: Pete, Lindsay, and Sam catch up to her.
sentences.zh: 皮特、琳赛和萨姆追上了她。

sentences.en: Nessie, wait!
But it's too late.
She rings the doorbell.
Hide!
Pete, Lindsay, and Sam hide behind a car as Rachel answers the door,
sentences.zh: 皮特、琳赛和萨姆躲在了一辆车后面，这时雷切尔来开门了，

sentences.en: still holding her phone to her ear.
sentences.zh: 手里依然把手机贴在耳边。

sentences.en: Behind her, we see pictures of her kids on the wall.
sentences.zh: 在她身后，可以看到墙上挂着她孩子们的照片。

sentences.en: Can I help you?
Yes, you can.
You turned my friend into a frog.
sentences.zh: 你把我朋友变成了一只青蛙。

sentences.en: Nessie holds up the frog.
Look, I just moved here this week.
sentences.zh: 听着，我这周刚搬到这里。

sentences.en: Maybe you don't remember what that first week in New York is like.
sentences.zh: 也许你已经不记得在纽约的第一周是什么感觉了。

sentences.en: My first week in New York, my whole family was murdered by Indians.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约的第一周，我的全家都被印第安人杀害了。

sentences.en: It was 1631.
Okay.
Native Americans.
But yes.
Exactly.
It sucks.
But now you live in a freaking pottery barn catalog.
sentences.zh: 但你现在却住在宛如波特兰家居目录的房子里。

sentences.en: You're living the dream.
sentences.zh: 你正在过着梦想中的生活。

sentences.en: Isn't it time to let bygones be bygones?
sentences.zh: 难道不是时候让过去的都过去了吗？

sentences.en: No.
No.
Yes.
It is.
No.
It isn't.
Rachel's eyes narrow.
The wind starts to blow a little.
Uh-oh.
Behind the car across the street, Lindsay, Pete, and Sam watch the action unfold.
sentences.zh: 在街对面的一辆汽车后面，琳赛、皮特和萨姆正注视着事态的发展。

sentences.en: Guys, we gotta help her.
Absolutely not.
Do you want to get turned into a frog too?
Yeah.
Kinda.
Sam runs to join Nessie as she yells at Rachel.
sentences.zh: 萨姆跑过去加入内茜，冲着瑞秋大喊。

sentences.en: Oh.
Oh, and now you're gonna cast some spell on me?
sentences.zh: 噢，现在你打算对我施什么魔法吗？

sentences.en: Is that it?
You know, everyone back in Wisconsin thinks New Yorkers are mean.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，威斯康星老家的人都觉得纽约人很刻薄。

sentences.en: Are you really gonna prove them right?
sentences.zh: 你真的要证实他们的看法吗？

sentences.en: Rachel's eyes glow red.
Sam steps in front of Nessie.
Get behind me, Nessie.
If anyone gets to be a frog, it's me.
sentences.zh: 如果要有人变成青蛙，那也得是我。

sentences.en: Gets to?
No, I mean, I don't want to be a frog at all.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我一点也不想变成青蛙。

sentences.en: Or a dolphin.
Sam is clearly pretty excited.
The clouds start to swirl in the sky overhead.
sentences.zh: 头顶的天空中，云层开始盘旋翻滚。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
And then, from the phone...
Metro Cable, how can I help you?
sentences.zh: 都市有线，请问有什么可以帮您？

sentences.en: The magic suddenly stops as Rachel answers the phone.
sentences.zh: 魔法在瑞秋接起电话的瞬间戛然而止。

sentences.en: Oh my god, yes, hi, finally.
sentences.zh: 天哪，没错，你好，总算通了。

sentences.en: I've been on hold for over an hour.
sentences.zh: 我一直在等候接听，都快一个多小时了。

sentences.en: My Wi-Fi isn't working.
Please hold.
Oh my god, no, don't put me back on...
The hold music comes back on.
sentences.zh: 等待接听的音乐声再次响起。

sentences.en: Rachel lets out a demonic howl.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋发出了一声恶魔般的长嚎。

sentences.en: Across the street, behind the car, Pete and Lindsay are agog.
sentences.zh: 街对面，车子后面，皮特和琳赛看得目瞪口呆。

sentences.en: Oh, she's mad now.
I don't blame her.
Metro Cable sucks.
The clouds start to swirl again.
Rachel turns to Nessie, about to cast a spell.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋转向内茜，准备施放魔法。

sentences.en: Nessie thinks faSt.
I can set up your Wi-Fi.
Rachel pauses, her eyes still red, the clouds still swirling.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋停了下来，双眼依然通红，云层仍在翻滚。

sentences.en: What?
I worked at Radio Shack.
sentences.zh: 我在无线电小屋工作过。

sentences.en: Please, let me take a look.
I can fix it.
A beat as Rachel thinks about it.
sentences.zh: 停顿了一拍，瑞秋在考虑这个提议。

sentences.en: And then, we're in Rachel's living room.
sentences.zh: 然后，镜头来到了瑞秋的客厅。

sentences.en: The whole gang is in Rachel's tastefully decorated living room.
sentences.zh: 一伙人都在瑞秋布置得很有品位的客厅里。

sentences.en: Rachel, eyes back to normal, sits at her laptop.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋的眼睛恢复了正常，坐在笔记本电脑前。

sentences.en: She's absolutely amazed that her Wi-Fi is working.
sentences.zh: 她对自己的无线网络能用感到无比惊奇。

sentences.en: It's working.
It's actually working.
It's just the most amazing thing ever.
sentences.zh: 这简直是史上最神奇的事了。

sentences.en: So, can you please defrog my friend?
sentences.zh: 所以，能请你帮我朋友解除青蛙咒吗？

sentences.en: Nessie holds up the frog.
Rachel smiles warmly at her.
sentences.zh: 瑞秋亲切地朝她微笑着。

sentences.en: Why, Nessie, the power to break the spell has been in your hands all along.
sentences.zh: 哎呀，尼斯，打破魔咒的力量其实一直都在你手里。

sentences.en: Simply give him a kiss and everything will return to normal.
sentences.zh: 只要亲他一下，一切就都会恢复正常了。

sentences.en: Seriously?
Nessie shrugs, closes her eyes, and gives the frog a kiss.
sentences.zh: 尼斯耸耸肩，闭上眼睛，亲了青蛙一下。

sentences.en: Everyone bursts out laughing.
The frog remains a frog.
I'm sorry, I had to.
Damn it!
Which is funny!
Rachel then waves her hands and turns the frog into Carl.
sentences.zh: 接着瑞秋挥了挥手，把青蛙变回了卡尔。

sentences.en: Was I a frog?
Was I a frog?
Was it awesome?
On a New York street a little later, the gang plus Carl walk back to the bar.
sentences.zh: 稍后在纽约的一条街道上，大家和卡尔一起往酒吧走去。

sentences.en: What a night for science!
An actual live encounter with a witch!
sentences.zh: 竟然真的活生生地遇到了女巫！

sentences.en: And we live to tell the tale!
sentences.zh: 而且我们还活着讲出这个故事！

sentences.en: Didn't get that feces sample, but whatever.
sentences.zh: 虽然没弄到粪便样本，但无所谓了。

sentences.en: Still a pretty good night.
sentences.zh: 总之还是个相当不错的夜晚。

sentences.en: Pete, Lindsay, and Sam enter the bar.
sentences.zh: 皮特、林赛和萨姆走进了酒吧。

sentences.en: Nessie notices that Carl has stopped to enjoy the look of confused non-recognition on the face of every passing woman.
sentences.zh: 尼斯注意到卡尔停下脚步，享受着每个路过女性脸上那种困惑且认不出他的表情。

sentences.en: He turns to Nessie, amazed.
They don't hate me.
They think I'm a little creepy, but they don't hate me!
sentences.zh: 她们觉得我有点怪异，但她们不讨厌我！

sentences.en: How can I ever repay you?
Nessie thinks, and then...
You know, it's too bad I'm the only one of us who remembers last night, because...
sentences.zh: 你知道的，真可惜我们当中只有我记得昨晚的事，因为……

sentences.en: It was a lot of fun.
She smiles at him, and he smiles back.
sentences.zh: 她对她微笑着，他也回以微笑。

sentences.en: In the bar, moments later, Lindsay and Sam watch Nessie and Carl out of the window.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后在酒吧里，林赛和萨姆透过窗户看着尼斯和卡尔。

sentences.en: Yes, Nessie's okay.
Of course, I don't have to tell you that.
sentences.zh: 当然，这个不用我跟你说。

sentences.en: You're obviously in love with her.
What?
No?
I'm not...
I have zero interest in her whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 我对她一点兴趣都没有。

sentences.en: And right before their eyes, Nessie and Carl start kissing.
sentences.zh: 就在他们眼前，尼斯和卡尔开始接吻。

sentences.en: Damn it!
Lindsay laughs and throws her arm around her buddy Sam.
sentences.zh: 林赛笑着把胳膊搭在好友萨姆身上。

sentences.en: We dissolve to Carl's bedroom.
sentences.zh: 画面淡出，转到卡尔的卧室。

sentences.en: It's morning.
Nessie wakes up next to a smiling Carl.
